senses.en_definition: A person in charge of employees or other workers; a boss or employer.

messages.en: Has the boss got to the office yet? I need a quick word with him.
Yeah, but he's in a meeting. Hang on a bit. I'll let you know when he's done.
I'm bored of staying at home all the time. Want to go out?
Yes! Let's grab a drink at that place near your house.
Are you at the jetty yet? The boat's about to leave.
Yeah, I'm right in front of the counter. Wait a sec!
Oh, I left my water bottle at home.
No worries, I've got a spare bottle. Want to borrow it?
